title: CURO Research Award — University of Georgia
compensation_details: $1,000 scholarship for one semester

eligibility.eligibility_text_raw: Per-semester deadlines (e.g. November 1 for spring)

description:
The Center for Undergraduate Research Opportunities awards 500 scholarships of $1,000 each year to University of Georgia undergraduates conducting faculty-mentored research in any discipline. The award covers one semester (fall, spring, or summer) and qualifies for Experiential Learning credit when the student presents at the spring CURO Symposium — UGA's flagship on-ramp into paid undergraduate research.

title: CURO Symposium — University of Georgia

eligibility.eligibility_text_raw: Annual; presenter application opens early January

description: The annual campus-wide CURO Symposium is where UGA undergraduates present faculty-mentored research as oral or poster presentations, with Best Paper Awards across disciplines. title: CURO Graduation Distinction — University of Georgia
description: A transcript research credential earned by completing nine hours of CURO research course credit (4960R–4990R), a CURO thesis course, and a presentation at the CURO Symposium. lab_or_program: Odum School of Ecology / Center for the Ecology of Infectious Diseases

eligibility.eligibility_text_raw: Annual summer cohort; projects posted each January

description:
A nine-week NSF-funded summer REU at the intersection of quantitative and experimental infectious-disease biology, hosted with UGA's Center for the Ecology of Infectious Diseases. Students design experimental, computational or modeling, and synthesis projects with faculty mentors. Open to undergraduates from across the country; US citizenship or permanent residency is required by NSF.
